# Prateek Saxena

> Group General Manager at Al Zaabi Group (Abu Dhabi, UAE). Operator, builder and strategist leading 42 companies across 11 sectors of the UAE's real economy. Industrial engineer (Purdue University), INSEAD-educated, Certified Management Accountant (in progress). Writes on business, leadership, operations, finance, technology and the UAE economy.

## About
Prateek Saxena leads the strategy and operations of Al Zaabi Group, a diversified Abu Dhabi group of 42 companies. Career path: Process Engineer at John Deere and Operations Analyst at Bose Corporation (USA), then Corporate Strategy Officer at Delma Emirates Group, then Al Zaabi Group (Operations & Strategy Manager - Deputy General Manager - Group General Manager since May 2021).

## Sectors
Healthcare, Automotive, Real Estate, Building Materials, Contracting, Manufacturing, Trading, Retail, E-commerce, Food & Beverage, Education.

## Selected partnerships
Saint-Gobain, Bosch, Jaquar, Philips, DAMAC, Henkel, Birla White (Aditya Birla Group / Grasim Industries), Asian Paints Berger.

## Education
- Purdue University - B.Sc., Industrial Engineering (2005-2009)
- INSEAD - Certificate in Global Management; Executive Education incl. "Transforming Your Business with AI" (2024)
- Institute of Management Accountants - CMA (in progress)
